This page shows the results of the test bed that tests the Yivi app against the [OWASP MAS EUDI Wallet profile](/edi-stelsel-certification/requirements/owasp-mas-eudiw). The test bed runs in the status checks of the app and writes these results; nobody fills them in by hand. The [conformance page](/edi-stelsel-certification/conformance/owasp-mas-eudiw) gives the assessment per requirement.

:::caution[Not a certification result]

These are the results of our own automated test bed. They are not the result of an evaluation by a laboratory. A test that passes means that the check found no problem, not that an evaluator accepted the requirement as met.

:::

## What is from OWASP and what is from Yivi {#origin}

Every test and every check on this page says where it comes from.

| Label | Where it comes from | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| **OWASP test** | A test of the [OWASP MASTG](https://mas.owasp.org/MASTG/tests/), taken from the OWASP repository | The test and its pass criterion are OWASP's. The identifier starts with `MASTG-TEST-`, and every such test here links to the original on mas.owasp.org. |
| **OWASP check** | A semgrep rule from the OWASP repository, run unchanged | OWASP's own automation of its test. The link goes to the rule in the OWASP repository. |
| **Yivi check** | Written by the Yivi team | Our automation of an OWASP test that OWASP has no usable automation for. OWASP did not write or review it. |
| **Yivi test** | Written by the Yivi team | A test of our own for a requirement, not an OWASP test. The identifier starts with `YIVI-TEST-`. These are counted apart from the OWASP tests. |

Which OWASP tests belong to a requirement follows from OWASP's data: the profile gives each requirement a weakness (MASWE), and every MASTG test names the weaknesses it tests. How a finding of an OWASP rule becomes a pass or a fail is set by us, in [`config.json`](https://github.com/privacybydesign/irmamobile/blob/70f13e842f438f1d9ce575308cc8fdc9e5d695ed/mastg/config.json).

## Basis {#basis}

- **Tested:** the sources, an APK decompiled by jadx, an unpacked IPA, on 2026-11-18.
- **App:** [privacybydesign/irmamobile](https://github.com/privacybydesign/irmamobile) at commit [`70f13e8`](https://github.com/privacybydesign/irmamobile/commit/70f13e842f438f1d9ce575308cc8fdc9e5d695ed).
- **OWASP MASTG:** commit [`e818303`](https://github.com/OWASP/mastg/commit/e8183038d7a88c1ac962732d6e3f6e7f40a0251c).
- **Profile:** OWASP MAS EUDI Wallet profile v1.0.
- **Test bed:** [`mastg/`](https://github.com/privacybydesign/irmamobile/tree/70f13e842f438f1d9ce575308cc8fdc9e5d695ed/mastg) in the app repository.

## Score {#score}

**OWASP tests: 29.8%.** 56 of the 188 OWASP tests in the profile are resolved, which means pass or not applicable.

**Automation: 45.2%.** 85 of the 188 OWASP tests have a check. 47 are checked by OWASP's own rules, 37 by our own checks, 1 by both, and 0 have a recorded verdict without a check.

**Yivi tests: 8 of 8 resolved.** These are not part of the OWASP score.

| Status | OWASP tests, Android | OWASP tests, iOS | OWASP tests, other | Yivi tests |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pass | 43 | 13 | 0 | 8 |
| Not applicable | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Fail | 6 | 2 | 0 | 0 |
| To triage | 11 | 10 | 0 | 0 |
| Not automated | 38 | 63 | 2 | 0 |

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Pass | The check ran and found no problem. |
| Not applicable | Recorded by hand, with a reason. |
| Fail | A check found a defect, or did not find the protection it looks for. |
| To triage | A check found something a person has to judge. |
| Not automated | No check runs for this test yet. |

The checks read the Java code, the manifests and the native binaries of the app. The Dart and Go code, which holds most of the logic of Yivi, is compiled to machine code and is only covered where a Yivi test reads the sources.

## Yivi tests {#yivi-tests}

Our own tests. OWASP did not write or review them. They are defined in [`yivi-tests.json`](https://github.com/privacybydesign/irmamobile/blob/70f13e842f438f1d9ce575308cc8fdc9e5d695ed/mastg/yivi-tests.json).

#### YIVI-TEST-0001 {#yivi-test-0001}

- **Yivi test:** No code is loaded at run time in the Android code
- **What it tests:** The Android code of the app and its own plugins does not load code at run time. Libraries are not covered.
- **Requirement:** [#49](#req-49)
- **Status:** Pass
- **Yivi check:** [`yivi-no-runtime-code-loading`](https://github.com/privacybydesign/irmamobile/blob/70f13e842f438f1d9ce575308cc8fdc9e5d695ed/mastg/yivi-tests.json), pass. A finding is a class loader or System.load call in our Android code.

#### YIVI-TEST-0002 {#yivi-test-0002}

- **Yivi test:** Clipboard writes in the Dart code
- **What it tests:** Lists every place where the Dart code writes to the clipboard, so that each one is a recorded decision.
- **Requirement:** [#30](#req-30)
- **Status:** Pass
- **Yivi check:** [`yivi-clipboard-writes`](https://github.com/privacybydesign/irmamobile/blob/70f13e842f438f1d9ce575308cc8fdc9e5d695ed/mastg/yivi-tests.json), pass. A finding is a write to the clipboard; a person checks what is copied. Result: 1 finding(s) accepted in triage.json.

#### YIVI-TEST-0003 {#yivi-test-0003}

- **Yivi test:** Error reports carry no default personal data
- **What it tests:** Error reporting never switches on the default personal data of Sentry, and the setting that turns it off is in place.
- **Requirement:** [#68](#req-68), [#71](#req-71)
- **Status:** Pass
- **Yivi check:** [`yivi-sentry-default-pii-on`](https://github.com/privacybydesign/irmamobile/blob/70f13e842f438f1d9ce575308cc8fdc9e5d695ed/mastg/yivi-tests.json), pass. A finding is sendDefaultPii switched on.
- **Yivi check:** [`yivi-sentry-default-pii-off`](https://github.com/privacybydesign/irmamobile/blob/70f13e842f438f1d9ce575308cc8fdc9e5d695ed/mastg/yivi-tests.json), pass. Looks for sendDefaultPii switched off. Result: 1 protection(s) found.

#### YIVI-TEST-0004 {#yivi-test-0004}

- **Yivi test:** Release builds obfuscate the Dart code
- **What it tests:** The fastlane release builds for Android and iOS pass the obfuscation flags. The F-Droid app is not built through fastlane and is not covered.
- **Requirement:** [#59](#req-59)
- **Status:** Pass
- **Yivi check:** [`yivi-dart-obfuscation-flags`](https://github.com/privacybydesign/irmamobile/blob/70f13e842f438f1d9ce575308cc8fdc9e5d695ed/mastg/yivi-tests.json), pass. Looks for --obfuscate with --split-debug-info in the Fastfile. Result: 2 protection(s) found.

#### YIVI-TEST-0005 {#yivi-test-0005}

- **Yivi test:** JavaScript channels exposed to WebViews in the Dart code
- **What it tests:** Lists every JavaScript channel the Dart code gives to a WebView, so that each one is a recorded decision.
- **Requirement:** [#33](#req-33)
- **Status:** Pass
- **Yivi check:** [`yivi-webview-javascript-channels`](https://github.com/privacybydesign/irmamobile/blob/70f13e842f438f1d9ce575308cc8fdc9e5d695ed/mastg/yivi-tests.json), pass. A finding is a JavaScript channel given to a WebView; a person checks what it exposes. Result: 1 finding(s) accepted in triage.json.

#### YIVI-TEST-0006 {#yivi-test-0006}

- **Yivi test:** Detection of dynamic analysis tools is in the code
- **What it tests:** The Android and iOS plugins still look for instrumentation tools such as Frida. This shows that the measure is in the code; how it behaves is covered by the unit tests in yivi_core/test/app_integrity_test.dart.
- **Requirement:** [#65](#req-65)
- **Status:** Pass
- **Yivi check:** [`yivi-instrumentation-detection-android`](https://github.com/privacybydesign/irmamobile/blob/70f13e842f438f1d9ce575308cc8fdc9e5d695ed/mastg/yivi-tests.json), pass. Looks for the Frida markers in the Android integrity plugin. Result: 1 protection(s) found.
- **Yivi check:** [`yivi-instrumentation-detection-ios`](https://github.com/privacybydesign/irmamobile/blob/70f13e842f438f1d9ce575308cc8fdc9e5d695ed/mastg/yivi-tests.json), pass. Looks for the Frida markers in the iOS integrity plugin. Result: 1 protection(s) found.

#### YIVI-TEST-0007 {#yivi-test-0007}

- **Yivi test:** Detection of app-cloning containers is in the code
- **What it tests:** The Android plugin still checks that the app runs from its own data directory. This shows that the measure is in the code; how it behaves is covered by the Android unit test AppIntegrityPluginTest.kt.
- **Requirement:** [#52](#req-52)
- **Status:** Pass
- **Yivi check:** [`yivi-app-virtualization-detection`](https://github.com/privacybydesign/irmamobile/blob/70f13e842f438f1d9ce575308cc8fdc9e5d695ed/mastg/yivi-tests.json), pass. Looks for the data directory check in the Android integrity plugin. Result: 2 protection(s) found.

#### YIVI-TEST-0008 {#yivi-test-0008}

- **Yivi test:** The privacy policy is linked before enrollment
- **What it tests:** The terms screen of the enrollment still links the privacy policy.
- **Requirement:** [#72](#req-72)
- **Status:** Pass
- **Yivi check:** [`yivi-privacy-policy-link`](https://github.com/privacybydesign/irmamobile/blob/70f13e842f438f1d9ce575308cc8fdc9e5d695ed/mastg/yivi-tests.json), pass. Looks for the privacy policy link on the terms screen. Result: 1 protection(s) found.
